import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Group data by breed and count the number of dogs in each breed
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Create a bar plot for the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette="viridis")

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Registered Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
